extractedFrom.name: Radio (component set) — via get_variable_defs on all 4 variants, 2026-09-01

$meta.status: PARTIAL — tokens land here per-component as extraction proceeds; the full-file sweep (search_design_system audit) has not run yet. Groups below hold only what extracted components bind.
limitations: get_variable_defs returns only variables APPLIED to a layer in the queried subtree. Tokens defined in Figma but not yet used anywhere will be absent. Audit token-group completeness with search_design_system, which lists variables whether or not anything uses them. This bit the dashboard extraction twice (Surface/Card, Critical/Content).

DUPLICATE NAMES SILENTLY DROP STYLES. The response is a keyed object, so two Figma styles sharing a name collapse into one — and the survivor's values get attributed to the wrong style. If a style looks wrong, check for a name collision first.
resolved: lineHeight: the API returns the sentinel 100 for Figma's "Auto". It does NOT mean 100%. Record as the string "AUTO" and emit CSS line-height: normal.
letterSpacing: EVERY value this API returns is a PERCENTAGE, not px. Store as letterSpacingPercent and emit as em: 10 -> 0.1em, 0.4 -> 0.004em.
textTransform: --text-* composites cannot carry text-transform (or font-family), so uppercase styles need paired type-* utilities emitted by the generator.
